title: Quietly Smoky Turkish Beans Kuru Fasulye
description: Smoky, silky, indulgent Turkish dish featuring sesame seed oil and lardons-render, perfect for a comforting dinner.

ingredients.name: dried white beans
ingredients.notes: such as cannellini or navy beans

instructions: Rinse the dried white beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then transfer them to a large tagliere or pot.
Add the sesame seed oil, lardons, onion, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot with the beans.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until the beans are tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Quietly Smoky Turkish Beans Kuru Fasulye hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
